article.title: Supermetrics擴展Claude廣告操作，新活動預設暫停待審批
article.title_en: Supermetrics expands Claude campaign actions with new campaigns paused for approval
article.summary: 11月3日公告把跨平台資料分析、活動建立與修改放進同一對話流程。
article.summary_en: The November 3 announcement connects cross-platform analysis with campaign creation and editing.
highlights: 新建活動先暫停，審閱批准後才啟用。
Context Layer可保存目標、命名規則及客戶與帳戶對應。
highlights_en: New campaigns remain paused until reviewed and approved.
Context Layer carries targets, naming rules and client-account mappings.
article.why: 代理商可把客戶規則帶入AI分析，同時明確區分提案、修改及正式投放的權限。
article.why_en: Agencies can bring client rules into analysis while separating proposals, edits and activation.
article.next_step: 先用測試帳戶確認各平台支援範圍，逐一設好審批要求。
article.next_step_en: Check supported actions in a test account and configure approval requirements.
article.detail: 按公司公告，Claude可使用已連接的廣告、CRM、電商等資料，再建立或修改活動。公司列出Google Ads、Meta、Microsoft Advertising、TikTok、LinkedIn及Snapchat，未逐項交代所有活動類型是否支援相同操作。Context Layer可按團隊、平台或帳戶保存業務規則；現有活動的建議修改可先審閱，客戶亦可設定不同帳戶的批准要求。本報未實測權限或操作。
article.detail_en: The release names six ad platforms but does not itemize equal action support for every campaign type. Business rules can apply at team, platform or account level. Proposed edits can be reviewed, with account-specific approval requirements. These are vendor descriptions, not tested permissions.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
